[BUG - MINOR] Threat preview depth slider thumb invisible on Firefox

The depth slider uses -webkit-slider-thumb pseudo-element for styling but also includes -moz-range-thumb. However, the thumb appearance may be inconsistent across browsers since -webkit-appearance is vendor-specific. Steps: 1. Open in Firefox 2. Look at depth slider. Expected: Visible white thumb. Actual: May appear differently or be less visible.

[BUG - MINOR] Glow ring geometry not disposed on module cleanup

In defendedPieces.js:322, disposeDefendedPieces() disposes glowRingGeometry but this is a const created at module level (line 30). If the game is reset multiple times, this could cause issues since geometry is shared/reused. Steps: 1. Start game 2. Reset game multiple times. Expected: Clean memory management. Actual: Potential geometry reference issues.

[BUG - MINOR] Threat calculation performance with many pieces

threatPreview.js calculateReachableThreats() has nested loops: for each piece, for each move, simulate state and get attacks. With MAX_POSITIONS_PER_DEPTH=50 and depth 3, this could be slow. Current mitigations (slice to 8 moves at depth 2, 4 at depth 3) help but UX may lag on slower devices. Steps: 1. Enable threat preview 2. Set depth 3 3. Play mid-game with many pieces. Expected: Smooth updates. Actual: Possible frame drop.

[WHAT] Compile pipeline.md documenting how P001 was built from start to ship [CONTEXT] Fetch all user messages throughout P001 development and extract: the initial prompt/vision, key decisions made, phases completed, blockers encountered, human feedback incorporated. Create a narrative timeline showing the workflow from whitepaper → roadmap → tasks → shipped game [CONSTRAINTS] Save as projects/P001/pipeline.md next to whitepaper.md and human-review.md. Focus on the process/methodology, not code details.

[WHAT] Research and compare Studio token efficiency vs typical AI-assisted game prototyping [CONTEXT] P001 Chess used ~27M tokens to ship a complete Three.js chess game with advanced visualization (attacked squares, defended pieces, threat preview) from a single prompt. Compare against: typical ChatGPT/Claude conversation lengths for similar projects, published benchmarks for AI code generation, industry reports on AI-assisted prototyping costs [CONSTRAINTS] Output as research report with data sources. Include: tokens-per-feature comparisons, context efficiency analysis, recommendations for optimization
